purpose: 6i: one launch, the RTX Hair On bundle with rt_hair_header_scene_pass inside it. With the bundle alone (card fill flag off) every wheel dolly and orbit window must show: the header applied at the scene G-buffer pass only, no label taken by the decal pass or by another scene pass, frame watchdog trips 0, no frame on cards, no switch to cards by any gate. Then inside the same run: rt_hair_coverage_keep (no switch to cards at all, also not for a draw that left the screen), the card fill for the visual record (full-width PNGs, still and right after a dolly, next to the same two without it), and last the control without rt_hair_header_scene_pass (the decal pass takes labels). STAGED, not authorized.
